metadata.format: 2026-27 official 12-team CFP access and straight seeding
metadata.automatic_bids: ACC, B1G, B12, SEC champions plus highest-ranked champion from American/CUSA/MAC/MW/PAC12/Sun Belt
metadata.ranking_proxy: Transparent eight-factor CFP resume score including schedule-adjusted Game Control; raw metrics are simulated and persisted for calibration.
metadata.game_control_method: NCAAF Game Control Index = 100 * (schedule-adjusted control AUC - .500). Played games use time-weighted PBP curves; future games use logistic(final margin / 12), capped at 35. This is an open index, not the proprietary SportSource/Matrix value.
metadata.cfp_sos_method: CFP-specific SOS = (2/3 * opponents' winning percentage) + (1/3 * opponents' opponents' winning percentage), with a small home/road adjustment. It is distinct from the site's power-rating SOS and is embedded in Game Control rather than separately weighted in the resume score.
metadata.top25_method: Wins over teams in the latest official CFP Top 25 only. No model-ranking substitute is used before the first CFP release.
metadata.game_model: Normal margin model, sigma=14.0; first-round higher seed receives team HFA; later rounds neutral
